known.title: Data loss: Preserve the reverted fix's records

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 4
Raise: Data loss
Case: normal use - after this revert merges, someone checks the board or release history. The revert deletes the original fix's state file. `src/forge/board.py:907` builds landed state from files present at the tip, and `src/forge/board.py:646` creates fix rows from those states, so once the merged branch is removed the original fix and its time and cost disappear from the board. `src/forge/releases.py:62` also excludes it from release contents. The revert deletes `plans/spotted/laptop-tests-before-push.json:59` too, removing the open, unrelated report about full-container test selection from the records read by `src/forge/spotted.py:85`. Preserve these records while reverting the code.

It names work-round and lane tests, repository rule tests, and a future release run; those can pass while an unrelated edit is included or a non-lane portion of the original commit remains. Record a comparison of the original commit's raw-parent patch with this branch's delta, excluding Forge's own records.
